 assert ref(pair['original']['path'])==pair['original'] and ref(pair['public']['path'])==pair['public']
 assert pair['original']['sha256']==pair['public']['sha256']
 assert os.stat(pair['original']['path']).st_ino==os.stat(pair['public']['path']).st_ino

points=0

 expected=np.sort([r[g['method']+'_localwidth_template_fraction']*100 for r in present]).tolist()
 assert expected==g['fraction_percent'] and ((np.arange(256)+1)/256).tolist()==g['CDF'];points+=256

for b in final['figures']:
 p=Path(b['path'])
 if p.suffix=='.png':

for name,digest in plan['dependency']['neural100_hashes'].items():assert ref(R/'src/demosaic'/name)['sha256']==digest
